description: The saved IconSize 96px and IconSpacing 16px are reflected in the icon cells, spacing, and panel size from startup.

assertions.comment: The saved 96px icon size, not the default 48, applies to the first item.
The horizontal dock DockItem width becomes 96px, matching IconSize.
The DockItem height becomes 104px: the 96px icon plus the actual 8px indicator-dot space.
The saved 16px icon spacing is confirmed in the unnamed Flow capture path.
The second item is placed at x=112: the first-item width of 96px plus 16px spacing.
The unnamed Flow capture path width becomes 432px: four icons plus three gaps.
The unnamed panel capture path width becomes 448px: 432px of content plus 16px of left and right padding.
The panel height becomes 112px: IconSize 96px plus 16px of top and bottom padding.
